svg.text: Everyday English - Small talk
What do you like to do to
unwind?
MEANING
A friendly way to ask how someone relaxes after a
busy or stressful period.
IN CONTEXT
What do you like to do to unwind after a long week?
USAGE NOTE
Unwind means relax, not solve a problem. Keep the
question open and avoid assuming everyone drinks
alcohol or enjoys the same activities.
CONVERSATION
A: What do you like to do to unwind?
B: I take a walk or look after my plants.
A: Have you been gardening long?
B: Only a year. It helps me switch off after work.
A: I could use a hobby like that. What is easy to start
with?
B: Herbs are forgiving. Do you have a sunny
windowsill?
A: Yes. I could put a small pot in the kitchen.
B: That is a good start. I can show you a few next time.
YOUR TURN
Answer with one relaxing activity, then ask a natural
follow-up question.
